entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand the situation, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault. The band is broken. It won't sync with my phone, no matter what I do. I followed all the instructions.

Okay, I understand. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the syncing feature. Since it sounds like the device itself might be defective, the correct department to handle this would be our Technical Support team.
And what are they going to do? I just want to return it.

They have specialized tools to troubleshoot syncing issues in real-time. They can quickly determine if the unit is defective. If they confirm it's a hardware fault, they are authorized to process a warranty replacement for you right away.
So you can't help me? I have to talk to someone else?

I can absolutely get you to the right person. For any product that's not working correctly, our policy requires a technical diagnosis first. Transferring you is the fastest way to get your issue resolved. Would you like me to connect you now?
Fine. As long as they can fix it or replace it. Just transfer me.
Of course. Please hold for just a moment while I connect you to a Tech Support specialist.
